column1: # Host implementations of guest functions, by module (psvrecomp generate --replace-table; ARCHITECTURE.md, "Host
# implementations of guest functions"; the functions are libs/recomp/src/host_functions.cpp).
# <module fingerprint (SHA-256 of the ELF)> <address or nid:NID> <host function> [<guard>]
# A line is added only for a module whose functions were read instruction by instruction and found to do what the host
# function does (results, memory effects, overlapping buffers; docs/CODEGEN_METRICS.md, task 8). The same NID in another
# build of the library is another algorithm until checked: WipEout 2048's libc memcpy (3a5c7681...) returns through r12
# and copies with vext, and has no line here.
# SceLibc and SceLibstdcxx (libc.suprx) as Persona 4: Dancing All Night ships it, linked at 0x81000000.
